fields.label: Content Blocks
fields.name: content_blocks
fields.instructions: Add and arrange content sections for this page.

sub_fields.label: Video URL
sub_fields.name: url
sub_fields.instructions: Paste a YouTube or Vimeo URL

sub_fields.label: HTML
sub_fields.name: html
sub_fields.instructions: Paste raw HTML here. Be careful — no escaping is applied.

sub_fields.label: Section Title
sub_fields.name: title
sub_fields.instructions: Optional heading displayed above the activity cards.

sub_fields.label: Intro Text
sub_fields.name: intro
sub_fields.instructions: Optional description displayed below the section title.

sub_fields.label: Activities
sub_fields.name: activities
sub_fields.instructions: Select and order the activities to display. Drag to reorder.

sub_fields.label: Image
sub_fields.name: image
sub_fields.instructions: Large banner image. Recommended: 1200×500px or wider.

sub_fields.label: Overlay Title
sub_fields.name: title
sub_fields.instructions: Optional title overlaid on the image. Defaults to the page title.

sub_fields.label: Image Copyright
sub_fields.name: copyright
sub_fields.instructions: Optional copyright credit shown in the bottom-right corner.

sub_fields.label: Intro Text
sub_fields.name: intro
sub_fields.instructions: Optional introductory paragraph displayed below the hero image.

sub_fields.label: Eyebrow badge text
sub_fields.name: eyebrow
sub_fields.default_value: Serving the community for over 25 years

sub_fields.label: Heading
sub_fields.name: heading
sub_fields.default_value: Empowering people to find their way forward

sub_fields.label: Hero image
sub_fields.name: image
sub_fields.instructions: Content image — alt text required before publish.

sub_fields.label: Phone note
sub_fields.name: phone_note
sub_fields.instructions: HTML allowed for bold. E.g. Or call us on 01467 629675

sub_fields.label: Heading
sub_fields.name: heading
sub_fields.default_value: Where would you like to start?

sub_fields.label: Accent
sub_fields.name: accent
sub_fields.instructions: Green = support/identity. Blue = referral/admin. Red = giving.

sub_fields.label: Heading
sub_fields.name: heading
sub_fields.default_value: Groups and services running right now

sub_fields.label: Highlight panels
sub_fields.name: highlight_panels
sub_fields.instructions: Wide panels shown below the circle grid (e.g. Information & Guidance, Financial First Aid).

sub_fields.label: Heading
sub_fields.name: heading
sub_fields.default_value: 25 years of people helping people in Aberdeenshire

sub_fields.label: Image
sub_fields.name: image
sub_fields.instructions: Content image — alt text required before publish.

sub_fields.label: Stats
sub_fields.name: stats
sub_fields.instructions: Figures shown large on the green band. Keep to 3–4.

sub_fields.label: Quote
sub_fields.name: quote
sub_fields.instructions: Include quotation marks.

sub_fields.label: Attribution
sub_fields.name: attribution
sub_fields.instructions: E.g. Day Services member

sub_fields.label: Fallback sessions
sub_fields.name: fallback_sessions
sub_fields.instructions: Shown when no future events exist in WordPress. Use for recurring weekly sessions.

sub_fields.label: Weekday
sub_fields.name: weekday
sub_fields.instructions: 3 letters, e.g. WED

sub_fields.label: Detail
sub_fields.name: detail
sub_fields.instructions: Time · Short description

sub_fields.label: Heading
sub_fields.name: heading
sub_fields.default_value: Two ways to make a difference

sub_fields.label: Panels
sub_fields.name: panels
sub_fields.instructions: Exactly two panels recommended: green (volunteering) first, red (donate) second.

sub_fields.label: Theme
sub_fields.name: theme
sub_fields.instructions: Green = white card with green CTA. Red = dark red card.

sub_fields.label: Note / small print
sub_fields.name: note
sub_fields.instructions: E.g. Currently recruiting · Inverurie

sub_fields.label: Logos
sub_fields.name: logos
sub_fields.instructions: Add each funder logo. Every image MUST have alt text (the funder name) before publish.

sub_fields.label: Body
sub_fields.name: body
sub_fields.instructions: Address and a line about access.
sub_fields.default_value: 54 West High Street, Inverurie, Aberdeenshire, AB51 3QR. Step-free access from the street, and the kettle is always on.

sub_fields.label: Map or shopfront photo
sub_fields.name: image
sub_fields.instructions: Needs alt text unless purely decorative.

sub_fields.label: Primary button
sub_fields.name: primary_cta
sub_fields.instructions: Defaults to a tel: link built from the site phone number.
